name: Z123 swap burns pool liquidity
summary: Z123's transfer accounting reduced the token-side balance of its own Z123/USDT pair during swaps, breaking reserve accounting and depleting the pair's USDT reserve.
notes: Z123 is directly deployed. Its 8,163-byte runtime is absent one block before creation and has code hash 0xacb835fd345d2907ce56731ff34da2dd1558a71bc72b7a6db10a235dbe2795c6 at deployment and immediately before the incident; both EIP-1967 code-selection slots are zero. The pair-side balance reduction is in the deployed transfer path and does not depend on a later configuration change.

Gross loss is the exact net USDT depletion of Z123/USDT pair 0x93515a5dbc2834d687721111d966de472d682a47 in the single successful incident receipt. The pair receives 18,000,000 USDT and sends 18,144,821.098489559914931458 USDT, for 144,821.098489559914931458 USDT net depletion. Archive balances fall from 169,648.381399323092651626 USDT immediately before the incident block to 24,827.282909763177720168 USDT after it, reproducing the same difference. The two bounded precursor transactions 0x8399ae01...750b and 0x4723af28...a1a0 have no USDT or Z123 transfer to or from the pair and are excluded. The incident sends 135,641.098489559914931458 USDT to the attacker and 9,180 USDT to the flash-liquidity provider; that financing fee does not reduce gross victim depletion. USDT is valued at par.
Corrects the seed's asset and scope: the victim pair lost USDT, not WBNB, and gross depletion includes the 9,180-USDT financing fee rather than measuring only attacker proceeds.
